raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 13 (ingest 2026-01-18) sent merchant_id as a prefixed, zero-padded string ('M-0121') instead of the plain integer used in every other batch, so the INTEGER cast fails. The 80 distinct values are 40 numeric IDs (100-139) plus 40 'M-01xx' IDs that fall in the same range as raw_merchants, so 'M-0121' almost certainly means merchant 121.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CASE WHEN merchant_id LIKE 'M-%' THEN CAST(substr(merchant_id, 3) AS INTEGER) ELSE CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) END AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
